table.name: AREA_CODE_STATE
table.purpose: Lookup table mapping North American telephone area codes to the U.S. state (or territory) they belong to. One row per area code; 305 rows covering 51 state/territory codes. Likely used to derive contestant or voter location from phone numbers in the CONTESTANTS/VOTES context.

col_001.name: area_code
col_001.description: North American telephone area code (NANP), ranging 201-989. Primary key; each area code appears once.

col_002.name: state
col_002.description: Two-letter USPS state/territory code (e.g., CA, TX, FL, NY). 51 distinct values, consistent with US states plus DC (or a territory). CA has the most area codes (36), matching real-world distribution.

table.name: CONTESTANTS
table.purpose: A roster of contestants, each with a unique numeric ID and a full name. Referenced by the VOTES table, which records votes cast per contestant.

col_001.name: contestant_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique integer identifier for each contestant (1-11). Referenced by VOTES.col_004, which links each vote to a contestant.

col_002.name: contestant_name
col_002.description: Full name (first and last) of the contestant; unique across the 11 rows.

table.name: VOTES
table.purpose: One row per vote cast in a contest: records the voter's phone number, their state, the contestant voted for, and the vote timestamp.

col_002.name: voter_phone_number
col_002.description: 10-digit US phone number of the voter (e.g. 7182887233).

col_003.name: voter_state
col_003.description: US state abbreviation of the voter (NY, CA, NJ; one value has a trailing newline, a data-quality issue). Likely derived from the phone area code via AREA_CODE_STATE.

col_004.name: contestant_id
col_004.description: Foreign key to CONTESTANTS.col_001; the contestant the vote was cast for.

col_005.name: vote_timestamp
col_005.description: Timestamp when the vote was cast (all within seconds of each other on 2018-03-09).
